title: Group Task Board
description: A Kanban-style task board for group projects. Tasks move through To Do, In Progress, and Done columns, each card shows a colour-coded priority, and owner names are suggested automatically as you add them.
role: Group project (Group 4) — built the board layout, task cards, move/delete logic, and saved tasks in the browser

title: Group Task Board App
description: The standalone, rebuilt version of my Kanban task board: drag-free column moves, colour-coded priorities, per-card owners, and tasks that persist in the browser between visits.
role: Solo developer: designed the interface and wrote all the HTML, CSS and JavaScript

title: Weather Now
description: A mobile-friendly weather dashboard that fetches live forecasts from a public REST API.
role: Solo developer: handled API calls, error messages and responsive layout
